title: [Epic] Foundation & Tech Stack Setup
body:
## Goal
Bootstrap the app from the bare stub: scaffold the project and get a deployable baseline.

## Success criteria
- the app builds without errors
- a preview deployment is live from `main`

title: Initialize the project scaffold
body:
**Parent epic:** #1 Foundation & Tech Stack Setup

## What to do
Replace the existing stub with a real, scaffolded project and wire up the base structure.

## Acceptance criteria
- package.json present with the framework dependencies
- the dev server starts without errors
- the base layout wraps every page

title: Build the site shell: header, footer, and global layout
body:
**Parent epic:** #1 Foundation & Tech Stack Setup

## What to do
Add the shared header, footer, and a global layout used across every route.

## Acceptance criteria
- header and footer render on every route
- the layout is responsive at a narrow breakpoint
